lesson: First-scorer slates need a modest set-piece-defender allocation when a captain or centre-back is a major aerial target; the five-player slate was too concentrated on attackers.
Avoid near-certainty on enforcement jurisdiction when multiple Channel/coastal authorities are plausible, and match the likely source's short country label when exact outcome strings are scored.
Do not omit the reigning champion and recent circuit winner merely because his team's latest result was weak; preserve a meaningful base-rate allocation.
A team winning streak did not justify 0.88 before track-specific evidence; separate one driver's streak from constructor strength and retain more weight on improving rivals.
The structural coalition and succession prior was useful and appropriately concentrated.
A striker-heavy first-scorer slate missed a midfield runner; include at least one credible attacking or set-piece midfielder when the top two forwards absorb most probability.
